_notice: DEMO DATA — synthetic, not real telemetry

hunts.name: Suspicious PowerShell
hunts.hypothesis: A lab account ran encoded or script-block PowerShell.
hunts.query: SF-004 OR SF-005 OR SF-006 OR EncodedCommand
hunts.expectedBehavior: No encoded PowerShell on WS01 during a quiet lab window.
hunts.suspiciousBehavior: powershell.exe with -EncodedCommand, or a 4104 script block.
hunts.investigationGuidance: Read the command line and parent process. Do not treat this fixture hit as a lab finding.

hunts.name: Failed Authentication Burst
hunts.hypothesis: One source produced a burst of failed logons.
hunts.query: eventID:4625 OR SF-001 OR SF-002 OR SF-013
hunts.expectedBehavior: A handful of typos, not a burst across accounts.
hunts.suspiciousBehavior: Many 4625 or sshd failures from one lab IP.
hunts.investigationGuidance: Group by source IP and target account. Confirm the accounts are sf-test-*.

hunts.name: Successful Login After Failures
hunts.hypothesis: A success follows a failure burst for the same account.
hunts.expectedBehavior: Successes without a preceding failure burst.
hunts.suspiciousBehavior: 4624 or an accepted ssh password soon after failures.
hunts.investigationGuidance: Compare the success source IP with the failure source IP.

hunts.name: Rare Administrator Login
hunts.hypothesis: A privileged account logged on from an unusual lab host.
hunts.expectedBehavior: Admin logons only from the known admin workstation.
hunts.suspiciousBehavior: RDP type 10 or a Domain Admins member logon from WS01.
hunts.investigationGuidance: Check logon type and the source workstation name.

hunts.name: New Privileged Account
hunts.hypothesis: A user was created or added to a privileged group.
hunts.query: SF-007 OR SF-008 OR SF-009 OR Domain Admins
hunts.expectedBehavior: No group membership changes during a hunt window.
hunts.investigationGuidance: Name the group and the member. Snapshot DC01 before any lab change.

hunts.name: Scheduled Task Persistence
hunts.hypothesis: A new scheduled task was created on a lab host.
hunts.expectedBehavior: No new tasks outside the known lab image.
hunts.suspiciousBehavior: Security 4698 for a task that is not part of the image.
hunts.investigationGuidance: Record the task name. Do not delete it until the lab test plan says so.

hunts.name: RDP Activity
hunts.hypothesis: Someone opened an RDP session inside the lab subnet.
hunts.expectedBehavior: No type 10 logons unless a test plan calls for RDP.
hunts.suspiciousBehavior: 4624 logon type 10 onto DC01 or WS01.
hunts.investigationGuidance: Note source IP, workstation, and account.

hunts.name: SMB/Lateral Movement Indicators
hunts.hypothesis: An admin share session moved between lab hosts.
hunts.expectedBehavior: No ADMIN$ or C$ sessions from WS01.
hunts.suspiciousBehavior: 4624 type 3 plus an admin share name.
hunts.investigationGuidance: VERIFY whether the share is on 4624 or on 5140/5145.

hunts.name: Linux SSH Brute Force
hunts.hypothesis: sshd on UBU01 saw a failure burst or a success after failures.
hunts.query: SF-013 OR SF-014 OR Failed password
hunts.expectedBehavior: No sshd failures from the Windows lab hosts.
hunts.suspiciousBehavior: Repeated failed password lines, then an accepted password.
hunts.investigationGuidance: VERIFY the Ubuntu 24.04 log path before treating a live line as this hunt.

hunts.name: Unusual Process Execution
hunts.hypothesis: A lab host ran a process that is not part of the quiet baseline.
hunts.suspiciousBehavior: auditd EXECVE for curl, or an encoded PowerShell process.
hunts.investigationGuidance: Compare the binary path with the lab image. This hit is fixture data.
